description: Open-source Windows and macOS desktop client built on DeepSeek Harness.
notes: DSH Desktop ships its own updater which downloads and runs the official NSIS installer; that can install a second copy under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs.
When the app offers an update, pick Later and run 'scoop update dsh-desktop' so Scoop keeps owning the installed version.

User data lives in %USERPROFILE%\.dsh and %APPDATA%\DSH Desktop. Do not redirect the latter into persist: the app rejects a junctioned user-data directory (userDataDir must be a real directory) and drops into recovery mode.
pre_install: # electron-builder NSIS: the application files are packed in $PLUGINSDIR\app-64.7z
